problem_statement: Small and medium-sized manufacturing companies struggle to detect machine failures before they occur, leading to unexpected production downtime, costly repairs, and missed delivery deadlines.
customer_segment: Small and medium-sized manufacturing companies operating CNC machines, assembly lines, and industrial equipment.
consequence: Unexpected machine failures interrupt production, increase maintenance costs, reduce productivity, delay customer deliveries, and negatively impact profitability.
assumptions: Manufacturing companies are willing to adopt an affordable AI-based predictive maintenance solution if it reduces machine downtime and maintenance costs.
proposed_solution: An AI-powered predictive maintenance platform that uses IoT vibration and temperature sensors to monitor industrial machines and predict failures before they occur.
